title: Republican Senators Issue Formal Warning to Trump Against Military Action on Cuba
detail: A group of Republican senators issued a formal warning to President Trump urging him not to open a military front against Cuba. The senators argued that US military resources and strategic focus must remain concentrated on the ongoing Iran war, cautioning that a simultaneous engagement against Cuba would overextend the armed forces and risk undermining operations in the Middle East. The warning signals rare intra-party friction on foreign policy, with hawkish senators acknowledging Cuba's geopolitical significance but insisting on prioritizing the Iran conflict.
